FocusFeature.title: FocusFeature
FocusFeature.description: A user-created custom focus feature or workflow module pinned in Focus Mode.

title.description: Name of the particular feature or focus workflow.

category.description: Category or target module in OpportunityOS.

description.description: Detailed specification or objective for this focused feature.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the focus feature.

targetMinutes.description: Target deep-work focus duration in minutes.

completedMinutes.description: Cumulative minutes spent focusing on this feature.

checklistItems.description: Actionable sub-steps or feature checklist items (max 20 items, each string <= 240 chars).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the feature owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the feature was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the feature was last updated.

FocusSession.title: FocusSession
FocusSession.description: A completed or active timed Focus Mode sprint linked to a particular feature.

featureId.description: ID of the parent FocusFeature document.

featureTitle.description: Snapshot title of the focused feature.

durationMinutes.description: Duration of the focus sprint in minutes.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was updated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/focus_features/{featureId}.description: Stores user-defined Focus Mode features, checklists, and deep-work targets.

/focus_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores timed Focus Mode sessions associated with a user's FocusFeature.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores verified administrator UIDs for RBAC checks.
